description: This file implements the 'HasPermissionCondition' class, which evaluates whether a user has a specific permission and optionally a specific action permission. It is used within the mini-language for conditional logic based on user permissions in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: HasPermissionCondition
classes.description: Implements a conditional check for user permissions within the mini-language, supporting nested sub-operations and else logic.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates whether the current user has the specified permission and action, using security utilities.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the sub-operations if the permission condition is met, otherwise executes else sub-operations.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers artifact information from nested operations for analysis or documentation.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Generates a human-readable representation of the permission condition.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns an XML-like string representation of the condition.
